sourceDetail: Cabin geometry (number, deck, geometric-centre x/y in the deck-SVG coordinate space, fill colour) parsed from deckmaps.com versioned deck SVGs (/data/out/msc/msc-sinfonia/vlatest/deck-<N>.<hash>.svg), one rect/polygon element with class "cabin-shape" and a data-cabin attribute per stateroom. Category legend built by matching each fill colour to MSC stateroom categories, cross-checked against MSC's official cabin-category scheme (Interior IM1/IM2, Ocean View OO/OL1/OM1/OM2, Balcony BM1, Aurea Suite SR1/SR2) and cruisedeckplans.com / cruisemapper.com deck plans.

notes.completeness: PARTIAL grid, and also the Lirica-class template. 897 cabin shapes extracted from the 5 deckmaps deck pages that carry staterooms (decks 7,8,9,10,12). deckmaps also serves 4 more Sinfonia deck pages (5,6,11,13) but each renders 0 cabin shapes. This 897 total matches deckmaps' own published Sinfonia geometry, but MSC's real MSC Sinfonia capacity is ~971 staterooms (some sources cite ~900-1,020), so roughly 75-120 staterooms are NOT covered here (deckmaps publishes no cabin geometry for several lower/utility cabin blocks). Treat this as a near-complete map of the decks deckmaps covers, not the whole ship; no cabin was invented to close the gap. LIRICA-CLASS TEMPLATE: MSC Lirica, MSC Opera and MSC Armonia are the sister ships of MSC Sinfonia and are NOT on deckmaps; this file is the Lirica-class layout template and can cover those sisters via cabin-number swaps, but exact per-ship cabin numbers/counts differ slightly and must be verified before relying on them for a sister.
notes.category: deckmaps encodes category only via cabin fill colour. 6 distinct fills map to 4 MSC categories. #f6c8d8 (pink, inner rows) = Interior and #fff (white, 4 accessible cabins on deck 7 sitting in the interior rows) = Interior; #68a4d8 (blue, outer rows) = Ocean View and #225397 (dark blue, 2 forward bow cabins 9003/9006, MSC category OL1) = Ocean View (these two are real-world obstructed-view bow cabins, though the source carries no obstruction flag); #78b984 (green) = Balcony (MSC BM1, decks 9-10 midships); #fac86c (orange) = Suite (MSC Aurea Suite SR1/SR2, decks 10 & 12). Mapping verified against MSC's published category scheme and the cabin numbers/positions. See colorLegend.
notes.section: DERIVED heuristic. x is the length axis, y the beam. Bow direction detected from cabin numbering (lowest numbers 8001/9003/1001 sit at maximum x ~756), so forward = high-x third, aft = low-x third of the global cabin x-extent (123.7..755.9); mid = middle third. Consistent with the Aurea suites (1001-1006) and forward bow ocean-view (9003/9006) falling in the forward third. Approximate.
notes.side: DERIVED heuristic. Geometric split of the beam at mid-y (~84.5): cabins above (low y) labelled port, below (high y) starboard. This matches the observed parity (odd numbers top/port, even numbers bottom/starboard) on a bow-to-the-right plan. PORT/STARBOARD CAVEAT: this could be uniformly mirrored versus the real ship; validate against a known cabin before relying on side. Forward-facing/centreline cabins near mid-y are least reliable.
notes.obstructed: deckmaps SVGs carry no obstructed-view flag; obstructed=false for all rows (source does not encode obstruction; not asserted as clear-view). Note: the two forward bow ocean-view cabins 9003/9006 (MSC OL1) are obstructed in reality but left false here to stay faithful to the source.
